budget.note: No vendor model was called. The only model peer is a loopback OpenAI-compatible mock created by the E2 case.

stages.title: Release-tool counterexamples first
notes: 50 gate tests: 21 original rejections plus 29 independent mutation cases covering wrong layer, dirty/missing/cross-commit source, unbound case, empty evidence, missing case, failed assertion, download bytes/digest, patch apply/digest, duplicate/unknown ids, native executed/version/attempt/evidence/model-task proof, staged-install proof, NOT_TESTED, self-claim, the exact wave-04 admission bundle, tier superset and no allow-gap.
full-product is a strict superset of every lower tier; main's admission probe now reports the E case PASS (verdict non-PASS).

stages.title: Independent verification of the current main increment
notes: Conversation catalog: persistent list, message/title search, pagination, CAS rename, archive/restore, archived readability, restart persistence and draft isolation, all through public HTTP.

Verification recovery: blocked→explicit recheck→same-candidate PASS→human accept→reopen, with old blockedId, wrong work, changed payload, replay and machine-FAIL negatives. Schema 400s and business rejections are counted separately.
The blocked state is injected on the isolated completion port; every observable step uses the real application and HTTP API.

stages.title: Assistant end-to-end and transaction-breaking negatives
notes: Consumes main's read-only C domain probe and records the three unresolved defects with owner C.
Validates persisted decision/proposal fixtures against the single public contract and rejects illegal variants.
End-to-end decision/context/proposal/confirm/reject/transaction cases remain NOT_TESTED because main has no decision/proposal HTTP entry in this checkout.

stages.title: Installation and recovery acceptance
notes: Recovery read-only startup is verified through HTTP: the marker forces recovery despite normal/native/assistant flags, business writes return 422, queues/events/bindings are unchanged and a second start stays read-only.

Portable installation, first-run, backup/restore and upgrade rollback stay NOT_TESTED because D's paths are absent from the merged source; planned negatives are recorded, including active-writer rollback, same-size drift, PID reuse and state-prefix collisions.

stages.title: Bounded cycles, final matrix and handoff
notes: Bounded mixed cycles (max 30 or 45 minutes) with attempt/begin/dispatch receipts and process observations; no port-count leak claim.
A full-product claim is rejected non-zero while native and installation evidence are absent.
